questions.qtext: Store $\text{A}$ sells raspberries for $\$ 5.50$ per pint and blackberries for $\$ 3.00$ per pint. Store $\text{B}$ sells raspberries for $\$ 6.50$ per pint and blackberries for $\$ 8.00$ per pint. $\text{A}$ certain purchase of raspberries and blackberries would cost $\$ 37.00$ at store $\text{A}$ or $\$ 66.00$ at store $\text{A}$. How many pints of blackberries are in this purchase?
questions.solution:
Answer: C

Source solution 1 (score: 0)
Let r represent the number of pints of raspberries and b represent the number of pints of blackberries in this purchase.

The equation $5.50 \mathrm{r}+3.00 \mathrm{~b}=37.00$ represents this purchase of raspberries and blackberries from store $\text{A}$ and the equation $6.50 \mathrm{r}+8.00 \mathrm{~b}=66.00$ represents this purchase of raspberries and blackberries from store $\text{B}$.

Solving the system of equations by elimination gives the value of $r$ and the value of $b$ that make the system of equations true.

Multiplying both sides of the equation for store $\text{A}$ by 6.5 yields $(5.50 \mathrm{r})(6.5)+(3.00 \mathrm{~b})(6.5)= (37.00)(6.5)$, or $35.75 \mathrm{r}+19.5 \mathrm{~b}=240.5$.

Multiplying both sides of the equation for store $\text{B}$ by 5.5 yields $(6.50 \mathrm{r})(5.5)+(8.00 \mathrm{~b})(5.5)= (66.00)(5.5)$, or $35.75 r+44 b=363$.

Subtracting both sides of the equation for store $\mathrm{A}, 35.75 \mathrm{r}+19.5 \mathrm{~b}=240.5$, from the corresponding sides of the equation for store $\text{B}$, $35.75 r+44 b=363$, yields

$(35.75 r-35.75 r)+(44 b-19.5 b)=(363-240.5)$, or $24.5 b=122.5$.

Dividing both sides of this equation by $24.5$ yields $\mathrm{b}=5$. Thus, $5$ pints of blackberries are in this purchase.
Source solution 2 (score: 0)

Let the number of pints of raspberries be R and blackberries be B.

At Store A:
5.5R + 3B = 37 Equation no ...(1)

At Store B:
6.5R + 8B = 66 Equation No...(2)

Subtracting (1) from (2):

(6.5R-5.5R)+(8B-3B)=66-37

R+5B=29 Equation no ...(3)

Now, checking the given options:

  • B = 12 -> R = -31 (Not possible)
  • B = 8 -> R = -11 (Not Possible)
  • B = 5 -> R = 4

Verification in Equation (1):

5.5(4)+3(5)=22+15=37

Hence, the purchase contains 5 pints of blackberries.

Answer: (Option C)

questions.qtext: Introducing a woman, Nisha said, 'She is the daughter-in-law of the grandmother of my father's only son." How is the woman related to Nisha?
questions.solution:
Answer: D

Source solution 1 (score: 0)

$\textbf{D.}$ My father's only son-my brother, grandmother of my brother-my grandmother and daughter-in-law of my grandmother-my mother.



Hence, Nisha is the daughter of the woman. So, the answer is $\textbf{D}$ Mother.
